blocks.html: I want to be careful here, because that finding is a function of my assumptions and not a law of nature. Change the time saved and the conclusion changes. But the structure is the point: an assist deployment adds the entire machine cost and the entire control-plane cost to a process whose dominant cost is the human minute, and then reduces the human minute by a little. It is the only tier on the ladder that has to justify itself against zero, and it is the tier most organisations deploy first.
